dataset: Q0 existing four same-frame captures; adjacent pairs f0->f1 and f2->f3 only
geometry_mask: Original Q0 camera audit: finite valid depth/projection, behind-camera/border exclusion, local linear-z relative span<=0.02; adjacent previous-depth relative consistency<=0.02. Never select by MV/color residual. Object selector unavailable.
MV_budget: 0.01 render pixel + 0.5 maximum adjacent half ULP, fixed from original Q0 audit; not proven GPU-FMA bound
SR_temporal_sample: Fixed integer guide texel grid stride8, 40px border; all geometric survivors; no edge/residual ranking. Tile parity ((x//160)+(y//90))%2 is fixed split; quadrant summaries. Common in-bounds domain shared by every candidate.
color_metrics: log1p(nonnegative Rec709 luma), bilinear sampling, luma absolute-error quantiles and joint gradient normalized dot. No exposure fit or thresholds adjusted to results. Metrics descriptive; SR history/color changes and unknown object regions confound phase.
identification_policy: Do not declare NR phase/model MVecScale from these tests. At most rank source-coordinate candidates on two real adjacent pairs; no adaptive grid or parameter tuning. Stop after this preregistered pass if ambiguous; do not rerun same root cause without new evidence.
Q1_check: Recorded extents/current/prev viewport+SR jitters and unchanged same-texel conversion; no Q1 camera matrices means no camera-specific mask inferred from Q0.
writes: New Q2 tool/plan/result/report only; existing source/data/archives untouched
